channel.title: EMRGNT AI Brief
channel.description: AI news for filmmakers, editors and post-production professionals, from EMRGNT (https://emrgnt.ai), a virtual film studio for films made by humans using AI tools. Each episode briefs you on the generative AI stories that matter for film, TV and post. Voiced with AI voices.

item.title: EMRGNT AI Brief: Pilot, Monday October 12
item.description:
The pilot episode of EMRGNT AI Brief: Netflix's AI use, AI editing tools moving into chat and real timelines, Vidu Q4 Preview, an XPRIZE-winning AI trailer heading for a feature, and lessons on AI agent guardrails. Produced with AI voices. More at https://emrgnt.ai

  1. Netflix has used AI on about 300 titles (The Hollywood Reporter) – plus Variety's report on Kang Yun-sung's roughly 40% savings: https://variety.com/2026/tv/festivals/netflix-ai-300-titles-kang-yoon-sung-40-percent-budget-busan-1236907359/
  2. Higgsfield Katana runs inside Claude via MCP (TAU-HOME) – also invideo Agentic Extend: https://invideo.io/news/introducing-agentic-extend-invideo-editor/ and Voyager (Founderland): https://www.founderland.ai/articles/voyager-launches-ai-harness-for-video-production-tools-mv2wdjer
  3. Vidu Q4 Preview (Unite.AI) – 2K/4K, 10-bit, up to 15 image references
  4. AI trailer wins the $2.5M Future Vision XPRIZE (Arts & Voices) – heading for a roughly $10M feature
  5. Anthropic discloses unintended agent actions (ThreatFrontier) – and US officials on incident reporting (Rainvent): https://rainvent.ai/genai-daily-october-11-2026-anthropic-pulls-internet-from-evals-white-house-makes-incident-reporting-mandatory-firmus-scraps-5b-ipo/
  6. Bonus: Final Cut Pro 13 leaks (AppleInsider) – Pixelmator round-trip, Natural Motion Blur, keyframe easing
